summary: Fortinet FortiDeceptor deception platform: fake devices and lures in the network, where any access is almost certainly an attacker.
value: An attacker quietly exploring the network becomes visible with almost no false alarms.
Decoys also cover industrial and IoT networks and the cloud.
Through Fortinet Security Fabric integration an infected computer is isolated right away.
simple: Fortinet’s deception platform: places fake devices on the network — Linux, Windows (with a Windows license), industrial SCADA, IoT, custom and cloud decoys in AWS, Azure and GCP — and lures (Deception Tokens) on real computers to draw the attacker in. Discovers devices on the network on its own and suggests where to place decoys. Any touch of a decoy is an alert with almost no false positives and rich detail: indicators of compromise and attack techniques (TTPs); through integration with the Fortinet Security Fabric, firewalls, NAC, EDR, SIEM and SOAR it helps isolate the infected computer right away. Hardware appliance, virtual machine, public cloud or a cloud service (Deception as a Service); licensed by number of networks (VLANs).
classification: One product (appliance/VM and Deception as a Service), the deception class; asset discovery for placing decoys stays in the text.
